title: Machine Learning Assisted Prediction of Porosity and Related Properties Using Digital Rock Images.
summary: CNNs predict digital-rock morphology from micro-CT images and XGBoost estimates permeability from pore-network parameters. The source reports predictions for Leopard sandstone (including stated MAPE and R²); outputs are image/model estimates without independent laboratory confirmation.
